subject: Mutual Action Plan: Next steps & stakeholder map for FinPay pilot
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>, Priya Menon <priya.menon@finpay.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap + MAP (attached)

Hi Alex / Priya -

Thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Demo highlights: streamed batch inference, predictable latency at 99th %tile, and private deployment options for regulated data.
- Success criteria you called out: POC with production-like traffic, integration with your SSO/KMS, and cost predictability for per-transaction inference.
- Risks we flagged: procurement/security approvals and a legal review for data residency.

Next steps I propose (attached MAP v1):
1) You confirm the economic buyer and the legal / procurement contacts (I think Priya is the exec sponsor?).
2) Redwood to provide SOC2 artifacts + short data processing summary (Rishi will help).
3) Align on MAP milestones and dates - propose kick-off call week of 7/20 to sync procurement + security.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a simple stakeholder list to help map owners. Can you confirm who should be on the procurement/contract thread?

Thanks - looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.menon@finpay.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + MAP (attached)

Thanks Marissa - great session. Quick updates: 

- Priya is the economic buyer / exec sponsor and will own budget approval.
- Samir (cc'd) is head of procurement and will manage contracting.
- Please send SOC2 and any required security evidence; our legal will review controls and data flows.

I've attached the stakeholder list from our side (stakeholder-list.csv). For the MAP, please add a procurement milestone and include expected contract terms (term, data residency, indemnities).

Proposed timeline: decision on POC vendor by end of August; pilot to start early Q4 if scope aligns.

Onwards -
Alex
VP Product, FinPay
alex.johnson@finpay.com

Marissa / Alex -

Thanks for the updated materials. Quick notes: 

- Confirmed: I am the economic buyer and the exec success criteria look good. Pilot KPIs should include: 99th percentile latency < 450ms, accuracy threshold on our fraud-detection prompts, and cost per inference target of <$0.003.
- Procurement: Samir will own intake. He expects SOC2 excerpt + SOW and our vendor security questionnaire answered.
- Timeline: pilot start early August works; decision by 9/6 is acceptable. We aim to select vendor by end of August.

Samir - please coordinate next steps on procurement items. Marissa / Camila / Rishi - please send the SOC2 excerpt and completed questionnaire by 7/17 so we can kick procurement.

Regards,
